say:3:1010121101:1.text: What do I do? What do I do?
say:3:1010121101:1.source_cn: 怎么办，怎么办，这可怎么办啊！

say:5:1010121103:1.text: The bridge is broken! I cannot return to Southville! My wife needs her medicine...
say:5:1010121103:1.source_cn: 桥坏了，怎么回南村啊？老婆子还等着我带药回去呢……

say:6:1010121104:1.text: Don't worry, Gramps. We'll think of a way to fix the bridge!
say:6:1010121104:1.source_cn: 老爷爷，你别着急，我们会想办法尽快修好桥的！

say:7:1010121105:1.text: Yes! The magister is a super powerful mage! All he needs to do is nod and whoosh! No matter how damaged it is, it'll be completely fixed!
say:7:1010121105:1.source_cn: 没错，我的主人可是超级厉害的魔法师！只要<male>他...
say:7:1010121105:1.male: Yes! The magister is a super powerful mage! All he needs to do is nod and whoosh! No matter how damaged it is, it'll be completely fixed!
say:7:1010121105:1.female: Yes! The magister is a super powerful mage! All she needs to do is nod and whoosh! No matter how damaged it is, it'll be completely fixed!

say:10:1010121106:1.male: Oh, really? You can do that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:10:1010121106:1.female: Oh, really? You can do that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:12:1010121107:0.text: Yeah, this sort of thing should be left to the professionals.
say:12:1010121107:0.source_cn: 没错，这种事还是交给工匠吧。
say:12:1010121107:0.male: Yeah, this sort of thing should be left to the professionals.
say:12:1010121107:0.female: Yeah, this sort of thing should be left to the professionals.

say:13:1010121108:0.text: As your temporary bodyguard, if you pass out again, I'm going to pass out myself.
say:13:1010121108:0.source_cn: 作为你的临时保镖，如果眼睁睁地看着你再晕倒一次，我也会...
say:13:1010121108:0.male: As your temporary bodyguard, if you pass out again, I'm going to pass out myself.
say:13:1010121108:0.female: As your temporary bodyguard, if you pass out again, I'm going to pass out myself.

say:14:1010121110:0.text: I happen to know just the person to fix this problem.
say:14:1010121110:0.source_cn: 我似乎正好认识一个能够解决眼下这种状况的人。
say:14:1010121110:0.male: I happen to know just the person to fix this problem.
say:14:1010121110:0.female: I happen to know just the person to fix this problem.

say:15:1010121111:0.text: I should go find him. Want to come with me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:15:1010121111:0.male: I should go find him. Want to come with me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:15:1010121111:0.female: I should go find him. Want to come with me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:16:1010121112:0.text: Don't go with him, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! He's being too suspicious. One glance, and you know he's up to no good.
say:16:1010121112:0.male: Don't go with him, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! He's being too suspicious. One glance, and you know he's up to no good.
say:16:1010121112:0.female: Don't go with him, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! He's being too suspicious. One glance, and you know he's up to no good.

say:19:1010121113:1.text: We also can't just leave Gramps here alone. Chippy smells monsters nearby...
say:19:1010121113:1.source_cn: 而且，我们不能让老人家一个人呆在这里。满满好像嗅到了，...
say:19:1010121113:1.male: We also can't just leave Gramps here alone. Chippy smells monsters nearby...
say:19:1010121113:1.female: We also can't just leave Gramps here alone. Chippy smells monsters nearby...

say:22:1010121114:1.text: You're right. I guess I'll go by myself then. You look a little tired, old-timer. Are you hungry?
say:22:1010121114:1.source_cn: 说得也对，那我就自己去找吧。老人家，你看上去有点虚弱，...

say:23:1010121115:1.text: *Sigh*... I'm ashamed to say that monsters took all my food...
say:23:1010121115:1.source_cn: 唉，说来惭愧，我的食物被那些怪物抢走了……

say:24:1010121116:1.text: It's okay, Grandpa. We'll go find you something to eat.
say:24:1010121116:1.source_cn: 没关系，老爷爷，我们去找一些食物吧？

say:25:1010121117:1.text: There should be some wild fruit growing nearby. I know there are some glowfly fruit around here. They're said to be very sweet and good for regaining strength.
say:25:1010121117:1.source_cn: 这附近应该有一种叫做萤瓤果的野果，据说很甜，是补充体力...

say:26:1010121118:1.text: Let's split up then. See you later.
say:26:1010121118:1.source_cn: 那么，咱们就兵分两路吧。待会见。

say:28:1010121109:0.text: So, for the sake of my ever-reducing salary, I ask you to take care of yourself.
say:28:1010121109:0.source_cn: ——所以，为了我即将被扣光的微薄薪水着想，还请阁下爱惜...
say:28:1010121109:0.male: So, for the sake of my ever-reducing salary, I ask you to take care of yourself.
say:28:1010121109:0.female: So, for the sake of my ever-reducing salary, I ask you to take care of yourself.
